title: US Treasury yields climb as strong jobs data, midterm polls weigh; 10-year yield eyes 5% again - The Economic Times
text:
US Treasury yields climbed as stronger than expected September jobs data pointed to a resilient labour market, while investors awaited the midterm election results. Falling oil prices briefly eased pressure on bonds, but the move reversed as economic data reinforced growth expectations and uncertainty over future US fiscal policy kept investors cautious.
